Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
traffic.model.Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Movable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Car, EmergencyVehicle
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object implements Movable
Abstract base for everything that drives on the street. Concrete subclasses: Car, EmergencyVehicle.
